title: Unit Event — Rekindle the Flame — Episode7 This Drive

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD's next goal is to stand on top of the world. As each member strives to better themselves, something seems to be eating at Akito...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I felt something different while hearing him sing just now.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What if this is the special something that KAITO said I might come across?)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Okay, Akito, you start us off!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Morning runs really are the best!
They do such a great job of getting your brain going!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, and since they get us warmed up, we can start singing as soon as we're done.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
We need to practice a lot more, so let's use our time wisely!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because if we really are gonna set out into the world, we've gotta make use of every minute and second we have...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm sure Akito's doing that as we speak!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you hear that? I think it's coming from the park.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you're right... Are people singing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What if him and Toya already started practicing...? Let's go see!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's Shinonome... But who are those other two...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya! What's going on here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't know yet either.
They were already singing by the time I arrived here at our normal time.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: What's going on? Why are you singing like that?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Is it because it's so early in the morning?
Or are you not feeling well...?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Oh, did you need a little more time to warm up? I did sorta rush you!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: This isn't what you really sound like, is it...?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We agreed not to hold back. Sing with everything you have. You did during that event, right...?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Is your resolve really that weak?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: You're gonna stand on top of the world, right? But you're never going to get there singing like that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, why do you know about—

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We're gonna be the ones who stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's so piercing and straightforward... But more importantly...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like I'm being shaken from the core...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm not about to let him walk away with this.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Just keep singing! Make full use of this feeling...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been a while since I last sang like my life depended on it.)

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
I knew it!
You can sing like a pro!!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Thank you!
That was totally awesome!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Sorry for my brother letting his emotions get the better of him just now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That's fine.
What he said actually opened my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But more importantly...
What you said about us standing on top of the world—

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: I need to apologize to all of you as well. I'm sorry if we interrupted your practice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you guys were already here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, but only for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Huh? All of Vivid BAD SQUAD's here now...!
I didn't notice at all...!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Whoa... There's so much I wanna ask you guys! Man, where do I even begin...?!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
We're out of time, Slade.
If we don't start heading over now, we're really going to miss our flight.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Then, let's go, Ceddy.
Thanks for agreeing to do this with me, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Sorry, but we really are out of time.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: That being said, we're aiming for the same place as you, so I'm sure we'll meet again...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
That's right!
We need to at least tell you guys this!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: You guys put on an absolutely amazing performance during RAD BLAST. But...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We're the ones who are gonna see what lies beyond Nagi's dream!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: So, we'll be waiting for you in the states!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Was he talking about Aunt Nagi just now...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... We all heard the same thing just now, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I guess the world must be full of guys like them...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Singers who can put on unbelievable performances like it's nothing...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What is it, Toya? Why are you staring at me like that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel like you're back to being your usual self.
